name: Large Scorpion
appearance: A two-foot scorpion with two pincers and a segmented tail. The Large and Huge forms range from tan through brown to black. The entry mentions rumors of white specimens deep underground.

Combat.name: Pincers and sting
Combat.effectNote: Each pincer deals 1d4 damage. The sting deals 1 point of damage and calls for a save vs. poison at +2.

Combat.name: Type A poison
Combat.effectNote: The Large Scorpion is the stated exception to the preceding lethal-sting description. Its printed poison damage is 15 on a failed save or 0 on a successful save.

notes: 1–6 appearing. Uncommon. The table lists swarm organization, any activity, carnivore, no intelligence (0), treasure D, and neutral alignment.
Average (8) morale. Special defenses and magic resistance Nil.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, p. 309.

name: Huge Scorpion
appearance: A four-foot scorpion with pincers and a segmented tail. The Large and Huge forms range from tan through brown to black. The entry mentions rumors of white specimens deep underground.

Combat.name: Pincers and sting
Combat.effectNote: Each pincer deals 1d8 damage. The sting deals 1d3 damage. A failed save vs. type F poison kills the victim the next round.

Combat.name: Pincer pin
Combat.effectNote: A Huge Scorpion can pin a target in its pincers similarly to the Giant Scorpion. The Huge Scorpion text explicitly allows the pinned target to fight back.

notes: 1–4 appearing. Common. The table lists swarm organization, any activity, carnivore, no intelligence (0), treasure D, and neutral alignment.
Average (10) morale. Special defenses and magic resistance Nil.
This creature entry specifies death next round on a failed Type F save. The Dungeon Master Guide general poison table lists immediate onset.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, p. 309.

name: Giant Scorpion
appearance: A five- to six-foot scorpion with a hard green carapace, yellowish green legs and pincers, and a segmented black tail ending in a stinger.

habitats: Subterranean areas, underground burrows, and dungeons
combat.attackOptions: Two pincers and one sting. The attacks can target up to three opponents.

Combat.name: Pincer grab
Combat.effectNote: Each pincer deals 1d10 damage. A grabbed victim takes another 1d10 each round until released. The victim gets one bend bars/lift gates attempt per combat as their sole action for that round.

Combat.name: Sting
Combat.effectNote: The sting deals 1d4 damage. It automatically hits a victim caught in the pincers if directed at that victim. Roll normally against an untrapped target. A failed save vs. type F poison kills the victim the next round.

Combat.name: Stinging frenzy
Combat.effectNote: At 1 or 2 HP, the Giant Scorpion makes two tail-only sting attempts per round. The entry states that scorpions can be affected by their own poison.

Combat.name: Aggression
Combat.effectNote: It has a 95% chance to attack any creature that approaches.

Lair.name: Burrow
Lair.effectNote: An underground burrow or dungeon lair has a 20% chance to contain 5d4 eggs.

notes: 1–4 appearing. Uncommon. The table lists swarm organization, any activity, carnivore, no intelligence (0), treasure D, and neutral alignment.
Steady (11) morale. Special defenses and magic resistance Nil.
This creature entry specifies death next round on a failed Type F save. The Dungeon Master Guide general poison table lists immediate onset.
